title: Internet Disruptions Due to Cable Cuts
what_it_is: Internet Disruptions Due to Cable Cuts

sections.label: Internet disruption reporting and cable cuts
sections.summary: IMDA has strict requirements and reports 26 Internet disruptions over three hours since 2013, 14 from cable cuts, with this incident caused by HDB project construction works.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: IMDA has put in place strict regulatory requirements to prevent such disruptions and ensure quick service recovery when disruptions occur.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: Based on reports made to IMDA under its Outage Reporting Code, 26 Internet disruptions lasting more than three hours have been reported since 2013.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: Of these, 14 were caused by cable cuts.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: This incident was caused by construction works undertaken by several contractors involved in a Housing and Development Board (HDB) project in the Jurong area.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: Investigations into past cable cut incidents revealed that most incidents occurred because contractors did not follow established standard operating procedures (SOPs).

sections.label: Worksite advisories and repair costs
sections.summary: IMDA circulates multilingual Dos and Don'ts at worksites, telco repair costs can exceed half a million dollars, and IMDA will work to minimise cable cut incidents.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: IMDA has also circulated "Dos and Don'ts" in multiple languages at worksites to alert workers on the need to exercise due care and caution when carrying out earthworks.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: I am told that the telecommunications companies' (telcos') repair costs alone can sometimes exceed half a million dollars.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: IMDA will continue to work closely with all parties involved to ensure that the number of such cable cut incidents is minimised.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: As to whether the company wants to do a gesture of goodwill, it is up to them.
